doc: Per-page related structures and functional groups, built by scripts/anatomy/q298/relations_q298.py from this project's own cited data and the rules in data/anatomy/relations_q298.json. `rel` maps a structure index to [[target index, kind]]; `fg` maps it to indices into `fgroups`.

head.label: another part of the same muscle
head.src: the page's own `part_of_id` / `part_of` record field, plus data/anatomy/muscle_heads_q293.json (Gray's Anatomy for Students 4th ed.; Moore's Clinically Oriented Anatomy 8th ed.) where the page ships the heads of a muscle instead of one whole-muscle mesh
head.why: Structures the page itself declares to be parts of the same parent, or named '<something> head/part of <the same muscle>'.

tendon.label: its tendon, aponeurosis or tendon sheath
tendon.src: this project's own structure naming (Q118 / Q122 generated connectors and the Z-Anatomy names)
tendon.why: INFERRED BY NAME: a structure whose name is '<muscle> tendon', 'Tendon of <muscle>', 'Tendon sheath of <muscle>', '<muscle> aponeurosis' or 'Aponeurosis of <muscle>'. No source states the pairing; the name does.

bursa.label: a bursa of this muscle or tendon
bursa.src: this project's own structure naming (Z-Anatomy bursa names)
bursa.why: INFERRED BY NAME: a structure of the bursa layer whose own name contains this muscle's name.

nerve.label: its nerve supply
nerve.src: the structure's own cited `nerve` field and the nmsk-learn `nv` list (Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed.; Moore's Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.), matched to the page's own nerve meshes by name
nerve.why: The nerve named in the muscle's own cited record, where that nerve (or a named branch of it) is itself a mesh on this page.

artery.label: an artery that supplies it
artery.src: the ARTERY's own cited `supplies` field on this page
artery.why: Read from the other direction: an artery whose own record lists this structure among what it supplies.

attach.label: a bone it attaches to
attach.src: the nmsk-learn `o` / `in` origin and insertion bone ids (Q283, from Gray's and Moore's, corrected by data/anatomy/muscle_audit_q293.json)
attach.why: The origin and insertion bones named in the muscle's own cited attachment record.

joint.label: a structure of a joint it crosses
joint.src: joint list per muscle: data/anatomy/muscle_actions_q283.json (cited); joint -> page structure: the `joint_structures` rules in this file
joint.why: WHICH JOINTS a muscle crosses is cited (Q283 action data). WHICH PAGE STRUCTURES belong to a joint is a rule of this project's own, listed in data/anatomy/relations_q298.json, because no page ships a mesh called 'knee joint'.

antagonist.label: an antagonist at a shared joint
antagonist.src: data/anatomy/muscle_actions_q283.json (each action quoted verbatim from the muscle's own cited record)
antagonist.why: INFERRED BY RULE: a muscle whose cited action at the SAME joint and the SAME degree of freedom carries the OPPOSITE sign. The actions are sourced; calling the pair antagonists is this project's rule, and a muscle may be an antagonist in one plane and a synergist in another.

continuity.label: a structure it attaches to or is continuous with
continuity.why: For the fasciae, tendons and retinacula, which are not in the Q283 muscle table and therefore have no attachment, nerve or action record of their own: an explicit, individually cited list of what each one attaches to or is continuous with.
